semiconductor_relevance: High — Comet Mechanical Equipment specializes in RF power delivery systems and X-ray inspection technologies critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Comet Mechanical Equipment (Shanghai) Co. Ltd. is a leading provider of advanced RF power delivery systems and high-resolution X-ray inspection solutions for the semiconductor industry. With over 75 years of expertise, the company supports innovation in semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in managing complex plasma processes and inspecting increasingly miniaturized devices.
capabilities: RF power delivery systems including Synertia® platform
High-resolution X-ray inspection for wafers and advanced packaging
Vacuum capacitors and RF matching networks

regional_presence.China: Comet has a significant presence in China, focusing on the semiconductor equipment market.
